title: herdr-peers debate panel proposal (panel-v1)
description: What `herdr-peers debate panel --json` prints: a seating proposal that was not executed (`executed` is always false). Seats go round-robin over model providers (the --kinds order, then any other idle kind) to maximize diversity; within a provider the idle agents in this workspace (or every workspace with --all-workspaces, minus panes in another plan's lead record, --exclude and panes that reported critical) and the accounts `ak pick` (pick-v1) proposes are ranked together by known headroom (most first), then unknown, then low; an idle agent wins only a tie. Never carries a secret value or an account identity. Producers may add keys within a schema version; consumers must ignore unknown keys.

lead.description: The lease owner address (--owner, default this pane).

providers.description: Seats per model provider (codex-xai counts as xai).

diverse.description: At least 3 providers (or one per seat when fewer than 3 seats) and no provider above half the panel; false adds a note.

succession.description: Up to two seats with the most known headroom (reported capacity or ak pick), best first, a provider other than the lead's first on a tie, for `lead claim --succession`; seats of unknown quota fill the remaining places (with a note). A new seat is local:<paneN> until it exists.
